phases.message: New hire access: Lobby and Bullpen.
You've earned a break. Break Room and Parking Lot access granted.
Now you're in the meetings. Server Room and Conference Rooms unlocked.
Promotion approved. Executive Wing access granted.
HR says you should relax. Wellness Corner unlocked.

hidden.rationale: Existing achievement, pay off 50 Bills in one run. Proposed binding, tunable.
hidden.message: A filing cabinet clicks open. You found the Supply Closet.

promotions.slicePolicy: Lobby/Bullpen start open. Parking Lot and Break Room are built behind closed age-45 gates. Far age-50 doors remain closed; Claude owns promotion opening.

placements.caption: BLOCKCHAIN. Parked diagonally across two spaces in 2021. Nobody remembers who has the keys.
EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH (2014). Still waiting for next month's announcement.
MY OTHER CAR IS ALSO A HONDA. A consistent approach to the midlife crisis.
Dave's idea. Facilities has committed to keeping it in the parking lot.
BRING BACK CASUAL FRIDAYS. Parallel parked with care and waiting for a hero.

birthday_banner.caption: Another year somehow. The cake is in a meeting.

cake_slice.caption: One slice left. Everyone is being professionally polite about it.

cart_corral.caption: These carts have gathered for a quick stand-up. It is running over.

coat_rack.caption: The coat has already put in its eight hours.

coffee_cart.caption: This coffee machine is the closest thing the department has to a meeting chair.

duck_row.caption: Ducks in a row. One has concerns about the agenda.

fridge_note.caption: PLEASE LABEL YOUR FOOD. The fridge has started referring to us as a community.

fruit_tree.caption: Low-hanging fruit. Finally, a deliverable within reach.

gauge.caption: Move the needle. The needle has requested a follow-up meeting.

giant_logo.caption: Our values: continuous improvement of the values statement.

goals_board.caption: Q4 Goals. Every arrow leads to another arrow.

kitchen_counter.caption: The microwave says one minute. The queue says otherwise.

lost_found.caption: Lost and found. Mostly chargers, optimism and one very good scarf.

parking_light.caption: The parking lights have stayed late again. Nobody has offered them PTO.

parking_whiteboard.caption: Let's put that in the PARKING LOT. Someone wheeled the whiteboard all the way out here.

reception_counter.caption: Please wait to be ignored. Someone will circle back shortly.

roundabout.caption: Circle back. This meeting has its own traffic pattern.

sofa.caption: Take a seat. The meeting is running a little over.

table_round.caption: An unbookable table. Somehow still occupied by a meeting.

trash_recycle.caption: Please separate the paperwork from the more optimistic paperwork.

vending_machine.caption: Emergency snacks. The emergency is the afternoon.

water_cooler.caption: The water is filtered. The gossip is not.

gateOwnership: Four closed physical gates only; Claude owns opening/navigation. Lobby/Bullpen plus Parking/Break Room floors are built. Server/Conference floors are future work.

labels.caption: PLEASE LABEL YOUR FOOD. The fridge has started referring to us as a community.
FISH SMELL WARNING. The microwave remembers what you did.
